title: paraconsistent-settling-associated-sheaf
description: The Belnap-designated parallel of the settling-associated sheaf: the constant-Z sheaf F_U^{(k)} built over the same Priestley space but using the full designated set {t, top} instead of just {t}, so it also counts paraconsistent top-cells. It refines the sheaf node by enlarging its designation criterion.

designatedSet.description: the full Belnap-designated subset of FOUR, enlarging the truth-side {t} so inconsistency (top) counts as non-trivializing information

newlyDesignatedCells.description: Delta^{+,Belnap}_tau(q): cells (s,o) whose valuation v_tau(q)(s,o) lands in {t, top} for the first time at stage tau; via Priestley duality their image sits in the dual space X_q^tau

firstDesignatedAtThisStage.description: v_tau(q)(s,o) in {t, top} and v_{tau'}(q)(s,o) not in {t, top} for all tau' < tau

stalk.description: free abelian group on the Belnap-designated dual points lying in the open set U; restriction maps are those of the truth-side sheaf extended over the larger designated set

truthSideInclusion.description: the inclusion {t} -> {t, top} induces a natural transformation iota: F_U -> F_U^{(k)} whose cokernel F_U^{(top)} isolates the newly-added top-cells, giving the short exact sequence 0 -> F_U -> F_U^{(k)} -> F_U^{(top)} -> 0
